implemented: Added a mediated vault-relative attachment read IPC channel that resolves only scanned regular files, rejects external URLs/traversal/symlinks and enforces an 8 MiB preview cap.
Added an extension allowlist for raster images, audio and video; SVG, PDF and unknown binaries remain inert and no external URL is navigated.
Added accessible image/audio/video renderer hydration through bounded data URLs, preserving embed labels, fragments and dimensions while retaining generation checks for stale previews.
Added focused policy, resolver and IPC validation tests without changing authoritative vault bytes.
limitations: PDF, SVG, unknown-binary, transclusion and external-open behavior remain pending; their placeholders do not load or navigate.

This evidence is local implementation evidence only; visible Electron, reference-Obsidian, human accessibility and cross-platform attachment behavior remain pending until hosted/runtime checks complete.
No provider, account, credential, personal vault or external reference runtime was accessed or modified.
